keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"a\"]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
